headline: How the fighting between the Houthis and Saudi Arabia is affecting gas prices
context: NPR's A Martinez speaks with oil markets expert Ellen R. Wald of the Atlantic Council about how the escalation in fighting between the Houthis and Saudi Arabia is affecting global oil and gas prices.
